+42
+

+[42,43]
+
+[.[] | .["foo"]?.["bar"]?]

+[null,null,42]

+{"foo":42}
+"Cannot index number with string \"bar\""
+
+path(.["foo"].["bar"])
+{"foo":{"bar":42}}

+{"foo":{"bar":42}}
+{"foo":{"bar":43}}
+
 ."foo"."bar"

+++ b/docs/content/manual/manual.yml
@@ -407,6 +407,15 @@
